messages.author: 495d67130a446b65
messages.subject: Error with prisamp = TRUE
parts:
Hello.

I am trying to generate samples from the prior distributions of this model:

model <- "
  # Latent variable definitions
  Alt =~ no_overlap_mixed_0_65 + no_overlap_mixed_1_7 + overlap_mixed_0_65 +
  overlap_mixed_1_7
  Inh =~ no_overlap_red_0_65 + no_overlap_red_1_7 + overlap_red_0_65 +
  overlap_red_1_7
  Act =~ black_arrows_pc + red_arrows_pc + mixed_arrows_pc
  IF =~ T1 + T2 + T3 + T4
  HV =~ CV1A + CV1B + CV1C + CV1D + IG11A + IG11B + CT + VL17A + VL17B + VL17C
  PO =~ gaze_duration_DF + regression_path_duration_DF + total_duration_DF
 
  # Regressions
  PO ~ IF + HV + Alt + Act + Inh
  HV ~ IF + Act
  IF ~ Alt + Inh + Act
  Act ~ Alt + Inh
 
  # Residual correlation
  Alt ~~ Inh
" 

When I run

priorSamples <- bsem(model, data = data, std.lv = T, std.ov = T, prisamp = TRUE)

I get the error

Error in eval(mc, parent.frame()) :
  Exception: mismatch in dimension declared and found in context; processing stage=data initialization; variable name=YXbar; position=0; dims declared=(5,28); dims found=(1,28)  (in 'model_stanmarg' at line 284)

failed to create the sampler; sampling not done
Stan model 'stanmarg' does not contain samples.
Error in rowvec[samppar] <- grep(stanvec[j], names(b.est)) :
  replacement has length zero

How can I fix this error? I am using blavaan_0.4-7

messages.author: 645e2b041ea2a63e
messages.subject: Re: Error with prisamp = TRUE
parts:
Thanks for the report. Here are two questions:

1. Can you estimate the model with prisamp = FALSE? (the usual model estimation)

2. Do you have missing data? If so, maybe try creating a copy of your dataset, except with all the NA values filled in with a number, e.g.,

data[is.na(data)] <- 0

If #2 works, there might be a bug. But it doesn't matter what is in your dataset when prisamp=TRUE, so it would be safe to fill in the missing data.

Ed

1. Yes, I can estimate the model with prisamp = FALSE.
2.  My data has missing values, so I replaced all NA with 0 and it worked with prisamp = TRUE.

Thank you for your help.
